# S.S Aqua Feeds & Needs (Siva Sai Aqua)

> Aqua feed, medicines, minerals, probiotics and aerators for shrimp and fish
> farmers. Beside Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple, opposite Siva Ranjini
> Hospital, JP Road, Bhimavaram, West Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, India.
> Established 1997. Same counter, same road, 29 years.

S.S Aqua Feeds & Needs is a small aqua trading shop on JP Road in Bhimavaram,
at the heart of the West Godavari aqua belt. For 29 years it has supplied
shrimp and fish farmers within about an hour's ride of Bhimavaram with feed,
pond medicines, minerals, probiotics, aerators and spares. Open 8 AM to 9 PM,
every day including Sunday.

Prices for feed and chemicals change through the season, so the shop quotes
them fresh at the counter rather than listing numbers online. Questions about
what is in stock today, or what fits your pond: call or visit the counter.

Pages:
- [Home](https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/):
  what the shop is and what it carries.
- [Our story](https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/story):
  29 years on JP Road.
- [Farmer's questions](https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/faq):
  answers farmers ask at the counter.
- [Water sheet](https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/water-quality):
  18 water parameters with the optimum range for shrimp and for fish,
  transcribed from the shop's lab report.
- [Visit us](https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/visit):
  address, hours, directions.
- Brands we carry (home page, #brands): 116 brand names as plain text,
  searchable. The same data as JSON at
  https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/data/brands.json (count, asOf,
  brands[].name) and as a PDF at
  https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/downloads/ss-aqua-brands-we-carry.pdf.
  Stock changes daily; the in-stock flag is a snapshot dated 2026-10-18.
- Telugu mirror of every page lives under https://shop-website-ruddy.vercel.app/te/
